dsh-plugin-muapi is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. MuApi media-generation tool: a muapi_generate tool that submits and polls jobs against any of MuApi's 100+ image, video, audio, and 3D models through one x-api-key.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-f44ef77611bd2b2e7b15.html
